note: Private campground in the Hand Hills on Hwy 851 near Delia: treed sites on a 30-acre park, about 50 of them seasonal (2026). Weekly-stay sites get septic truck service; short-stay campers use the dump station. Stocked fish pond, mini golf, Saturday farmers market. --Claude
